subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add a public portable batch-selection action to the message presentation and plugin SDK contract, and what fallback semantics should channels without native multi-select use?
rationale: This changes a public cross-channel contract and requires a deliberate choice about batch result ownership, submission, and degradation across unequal channel capabilities.

options.title: Add portable batch select
options.body: Define a typed multi-select block and structured array result with native renderers plus a documented text fallback.

options.title: Defer to forms API
options.body: Design a broader portable structured-input or form contract first and include multi-select as one field type.

options.title: Keep provider-specific
options.body: Leave batch selection to channel-specific plugin APIs and retain scalar select in the portable presentation contract.

recommendation.title: Add portable batch select
recommendation.body: Define a typed multi-select block and structured array result with native renderers plus a documented text fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history and the prior review tie him most directly to the shared presentation contract and product boundary.
